plugins.description: See your Command Code plan usage (5-hour and weekly rolling windows, monthly credits or balance) right inside the ZCode conversation, with a remaining-requests estimate and a burn-rate warning. Requires a Command Code plan.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在 ZCode 对话里直接查看 Command Code 套餐用量（5 小时与每周滚动窗口、月度额度或余额），含剩余次数估算与超限预警。需要 Command Code 套餐。

examplePrompts: How much Command Code quota do I have left, and is it enough to finish this task?

zh-CN: 我 Command Code 额度还剩多少？够不够把这个任务跑完？
